predeclared.transient_cases: F0 (no fault) and patch fault at 600 s for w in {2 mm, 20 mm}, planar, open rear, body 5 W on [0,900) s, sensor 0.1 W throughout, horizon 3600 s; plus 1-D uniform F2 (n_y=1) for comparison

hypotheses.HYP1: T_H(ref) <= T_H(w) <= T_H(uniform F2), non-decreasing in w (same rear state).
hypotheses.HYP2: Film midplane over the patch centre is <= unfaulted value (a cool spot, not a hot spot) and >= T_mid(uniform F2) - [T_H(uniform F2) - T_H(w)].
hypotheses.HYP3: Open rear: |T_mid_edge(w) - T_mid_edge(ref)| < 0.1 K for all w <= 20 mm.
hypotheses.HYP4: Open rear: |T_mid_centre(w) - T_mid_centre(ref)| >= 0.5 K for w >= 5 mm and < 0.5 K for w = 1 mm.
hypotheses.HYP5: Fitted lateral decay length within 25 % of the two-layer modal value; fin estimate within factor 2.
hypotheses.HYP6: Blocked rear: max film and max surface temperature with a patch do not exceed the uniform-F2 blocked values by more than 0.5 K (convection-dominated front path).
